points: The Q3 2026 print will show whether the +23.86% upward revenue estimate revision over the past 90 days is backed by actual order flow, or merely analysts catching up; a result that tracks that direction supports the long.
With FY1 EPS consensus at $0.73 and year-over-year earnings growth pegged at 0%, the earnings bar is low; any beat or raised full-year guidance would be a clear catalyst for the long side.

At roughly 20.7x FY1 earnings and 1.49x sales, with a P/E at 0.7x the theme median, Sonos looks fairly valued to cheap; Q3 margin stability would give the multiple room to expand versus consumer-electronics peers.
Sonos reports on October 26, ahead of AAPL, GRMN, MSFT and ROKU later that week; a strong guide would set a positive read-through for smart-home audio and holiday consumer-electronics demand.

Reports suggest Sonos recently posted a very large EPS beat; the upcoming call's Q4/holiday outlook and new-product sell-through commentary will reveal whether that momentum carried into the back half.
Analyst revisions are skewed positive, with 1 up and 0 down over the last 30 days; the long trade relies on management confirming, not walking back, that modest optimism.
watch: Revenue growth tracks the +23.86% 90-day estimate direction — supports the long.
Gross margin holds or expands — supports the long.
Q4/holiday guidance is maintained or raised — supports the long.
FY1 EPS estimates move higher after the print — supports the long.
